notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Plains that enters the battlefield untapped.
description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color that can only be spent to cast your commander.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning any Plains that enters the battlefield untapped to your hand from the battlefield, returning Jeweled Lotus  from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Jeweled Lotus enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting a Plains from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
